campaign_brief.objective: Introduce the Radboards KingSong S22 Pro as the ultimate electric unicycle for serious riders seeking adventure and robust performance on varied Indian terrain.
campaign_brief.key_message: Experience unmatched power and comfort for every adventure with the Radboards KingSong S22 Pro, built to conquer challenging terrain.

proof_points.claim: Smooth ride over rough terrain with advanced suspension.

proof_points.claim: Explore further on a single charge, covering long distances.
Tackle steep inclines with impressive power.

script.title: KingSong S22 Pro: Built for Adventure

beats.line: Beyond the city. Your adventure starts now.
beats.on_screen: Dynamic title card: Radboards. KingSong S22 Pro

beats.line: Don't let rough terrain or long distances limit your exploration.
beats.on_screen: Quick cuts of challenging Indian terrain: potholes, gravel path, steep incline

beats.line: Meet the Radboards KingSong S22 Pro. Built for serious riders.
beats.on_screen: Hero shot of the KingSong S22 Pro in action, with a rider confidently gliding.

beats.line: It features 130mm adjustable suspension for any path. An 8500W peak motor handles 40-degree inclines. Reach up to 70 km/h, with up to 200 km range. An 8-LED headlight guides night rides. A comfy seat and power pads ensure comfort.
beats.on_screen: Visual sequence: suspension flexing, rider climbing a hill, speed/range graphic, headlight beam cutting through darkness, close-up of seat/pads.

beats.line: Ready to explore? Get your KingSong S22 Pro at radboards.in.
beats.on_screen: Product shot with call to action overlay: 'radboards.in'

caption:
Ready for real adventure? The KingSong S22 Pro takes you there. 🚀 Its 130mm adjustable suspension smooths out any path. Tackle 40-degree inclines with 8500W peak power. Ride up to 70 km/h, covering up to 200 km. Night? No problem, with an 8-LED headlight. Stay comfy with the integrated seat.

Explore without limits. Get yours at radboards.in!

*Range, speed and charge-time figures are manufacturer claims and vary with rider weight, terrain and temperature.
